entries.title: A focused iPhone or iPad keeps other projects' cards off Home
entries.body: While your iPhone or iPad is focused on one project, Home leaves out the cards about other projects' tasks, as your computer does; the row under the top bar still counts what waits elsewhere. Pick their project or All projects to bring them back where they were, with any that arrived meanwhile still marked new. Tap a card's notification to see it anyway, without changing the focus.

picture.alt: An iPhone focused on the north-pier project: the row under the top bar reads 1 waiting elsewhere, and Home shows a note that belongs to no task
